pullRequests.title: fix(port): keep Vulkan instance buffers in the frame ring
pullRequests.author: pezzadev
pullRequests.head: codex/vulkan-buffer-alignment
pullRequests.body:
Fix corrupted and disappearing Vulkan geometry by keeping instanced vertex data in the frame ring. Persistent instance buffers reproduce the failure on the AMD Radeon 780M Windows driver; per-vertex and index buffers still retain persistent storage.
Validated with the NTSC build, all 10 OpenGL/Vulkan renderer checks, 20-frame renderer replays of Veldin and Novalis, and an in-game Novalis comparison against OpenGL. Other planets and GPUs remain untested.

commits.headline: fix(port/rac1-ntsc): FUN_001f9ad8 computes the whole cross product before storing
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The VU computes x, y and z before the sqc2 stores them; the C wrote x
before reading a.x for z, so the level code's in-place calls
(FastVecCross(m1, m1, m3) and the like) were wrong. PAL's twin got this fix
in 2c6ac4de. It also stores 0 for w, which the sqc2 takes from vf3: the
same instruction words in PAL left 0 on every call fcheck captured.

commits.headline: fix(port): turn Vulkan on in Mac build folders configured before it
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
A build folder configured while Apple's default was OFF kept it in its
cache, and CI restores cached configurations: the 0.8.1 macOS job built
the games without Vulkan, so their bundles carried no MoltenVK and the
job's check failed. Apple's build folders are now switched on once;
a later -DOPENRAC_VULKAN=OFF still holds.

Verified: a cache with OPENRAC_VULKAN=OFF reconfigures to ON and finds
MoltenVK.
